story_overview: In a dimly lit office, Marcus is comforted by his colleague Leo. The story follows Julian, a priest, who becomes entangled in relationships with both Eva and Clara. Tensions rise as Marcus, also connected to Eva, is seen with a reenactment suit, while other characters like Nora and Ryan observe the unfolding drama.
